test_bit4_not_set_in_any_shariah_mask().notice: Bit 4 (index 4 = RESERVED_4) must NOT be set in either Shariah mask.

test_conservativeMask_is_6().notice: SHARIAH_CONSERVATIVE executor mask updated in Task F to 38 (0b100110 = bits 1,2,5:         Gold Spread + Halal LP + Gold Allocation).  Old value 6 was pre-Task F.

test_dynamicMask_is_15().notice: SHARIAH_DYNAMIC executor mask updated in Task F to 47 (0b101111 = bits 0-3,5:         all active halal strategies including Gold Allocation).  Old value 15 was pre-Task F.

test_ousg_not_in_permittedAssets_by_defa.notice: permittedAssets[OUSG] must be false by default (never added in constructor         after Task A — only USDC is added in the constructor).

test_owner_can_add_asset_but_ousg_starts.notice: Owner can add a permitted asset but OUSG should never be added per SR-001;         this test confirms the flag is false out of the box and requires an explicit         owner action to set it (which the board must not approve per SR-001).

test_rwaAdapter_not_screened_reverts().notice: deployCapital to an unscreened adapter must revert AdapterNotScreened. The rwaAdapterAddr was never screened (setUp doesn't screen it) so this covers the post-recall / post-unscreen state.

test_scoreAggregator_accepts_indices_0_t.notice: Writes to indices 0–3 still succeed (not deprecated).

test_scoreAggregator_batchRejects_index4.notice: writeBatchScores including index 4 must revert StrategyDeprecated.

test_scoreAggregator_rejects_index4().notice: writeScore for strategy index 4 must revert StrategyDeprecated.

test_screened_adapter_can_be_deployed_to.notice: Even if we screen the adapter, deploying to an OUSG-like address that is not in permittedAssets doesn't matter here — the asset check is on the vault asset (USDC), which IS permitted.  The real guard is the screened mapping. This test verifies setScreened → deploy succeeds (confirming the guard is the only gatekeeper).
